standard_prerequisites.use: The existence of etale surjective presentations (Spaces, lift-morphism-presentations), the etale localization of the conormal sheaf and the functoriality map (same chapter), and the schemes case (Morphisms, conormal-functorial-flat); cited inputs with the descent reduction written in the retained span.

core_obligations: Choose a commutative presentation diagram with U -> X and U' -> X' surjective etale morphisms of schemes.
Reduce the statement to the schemes case using the etale-conormal identification and the functoriality compatibility.
Conclude surjectivity in general and the isomorphism in the flat case from the cited schemes lemma.

proof_roadmap.step: Pick the etale surjective presentation of the fibre product diagram.
Descend to the schemes case and apply the schemes flat base change lemma.

difficulty_reason: In a fibre product diagram of algebraic spaces with i and i' immersions, the canonical map f^*C_{Z'/X'} -> C_{Z/X} of the plain functoriality lemma is always surjective, and is an isomorphism when g is flat. The proof is a written descent argument: choose an etale surjective presentation of the diagram by schemes (with the existence lemma cited), use the etale-conormal and conormal-functorial-more lemmas to reduce the question to schemes, and cite the schemes case of the flat base change statement in Morphisms. Retained author proof at lines 572-588.
